answer: A bond is refunded only after 27 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ivory counter is kept in quartz and meadow publishes each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 27 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The attacker spends 96 dollars and 3 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
